ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, all structural borders, hairline page frames, link underlines — the single typographic ink

fog.$description: Fog — Page background, watermark-level surfaces, lightest borders

ash.$description: Ash — Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators.

neue-montreal.$description: All structural UI text: top-bar name, contact link, filter nav, project labels, category tags. Weight 300 for uppercase nav and filter items, 400 for body, 500 for active filter ('All') and project names. Letter-spacing opens dramatically at small sizes (0.07em at 12px) to give the nav a typeset, editorial cadence.

ryhmes.$description: Display serif used exclusively for project titles overlaid on hero imagery (e.g. 'recreation', 'BROWN JORDAN'). Weight 300 — the thinnest possible stroke — combined with tight tracking (-0.03em) makes the text feel etched into the photograph rather than placed on top. This serif is the portfolio's only expressive voice; it never appears in chrome, nav, or labels.
